Store a provider credential in a secret backend and wire it into `[proxy.<provider>]` (the default) or a per-VM override. Anthropic (Claude) is the default provider; pass `--openai` for Codex

Usage: iso proxy setup [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --openai     Configure the `OpenAI` (Codex) upstream instead of Anthropic. `OpenAI` keys are always injected as `Authorization: Bearer`
      --anthropic  Configure the Anthropic (Claude) upstream (the default provider)
      --vm <NAME>  Store the credential as a per-VM override for this instance instead of the global `[proxy.<provider>]` default
      --api-key    Anthropic only: store an API key (`x-api-key`) instead of a Claude `setup-token`. Ignored for `--openai` (always Bearer)
  -h, --help       Print help
